description: List the ads the team's store already holds, from the Meta Ad Library and TikTok's, to build an AI UGC video like one: the ad of write_scripts, quote_video and make_video takes an id from here. They are read from what is kept, so nothing is looked up, and no product read or ad link of the day is counted. The store's Competitors, then the Winning ads of its kind, each longest running first, then the Meta Ad Library links the team pasted, newest first, each ad once; source lists one of them alone. Each has id, source, library, advertiser, title, days_running and video, and ad takes only one whose video is true. Up to limit ads in one answer, with no paging; a store that holds none, or a team whose Competitors are locked, answers an empty list. Free.

limit.description: How many ads to list. 20 by default.

source.description: One source alone. All of them by default.
